errors.not_found.title: Not found
errors.not_found.detail: No resource exists with this identifier.
errors.forbidden.title: Forbidden
errors.forbidden.detail: You are not allowed to perform this action.
errors.unauthorized.title: Sign-in required
errors.unauthorized.detail: This action requires a valid session.
errors.validation.title: Invalid request
errors.validation.detail: The request could not be accepted because some fields are invalid.
errors.conflict.title: Conflict
errors.conflict.detail: This operation conflicts with the current state of the resource.
errors.policy_engine_unavailable.title: Policy engine unavailable
errors.policy_engine_unavailable.detail: The permission check could not be completed, so the request was denied.
errors.rate_limited.title: Too many requests
errors.rate_limited.detail: You exceeded the allowed request rate. Try again later.
errors.internal.title: Internal error
errors.internal.detail: An unexpected error occurred. It was recorded under the request identifier.
errors.invalid_identifier.title: Invalid identifier
errors.invalid_identifier.detail: The public identifier is malformed or contains a typing error.
errors.review_transition.title: Review transition not allowed
errors.review_transition.detail: The review task cannot move to this state from its current state.
errors.grant_token_invalid.title: Reader credential invalid
errors.grant_token_invalid.detail: The reader credential is missing, expired or belongs to another session.
errors.reader_session_ended.title: Reading session ended
errors.reader_session_ended.detail: This session is over. Open the book again to continue.
errors.device_limit.title: Device limit reached
errors.device_limit.detail: This grant is already open on the maximum number of devices. Close the reader on another device and try again.
errors.grant_required.title: A grant is required
errors.grant_required.detail: Reading this work requires an active grant.
errors.tile_request_invalid.title: Invalid image request
errors.tile_request_invalid.detail: The requested image parameters are not supported.
errors.tile_too_large.title: Image larger than permitted
errors.tile_too_large.detail: Protected pages are served as small tiles only.
errors.print_quota_exceeded.title: Print quota exceeded
errors.print_quota_exceeded.detail: This grant does not have enough print quota left for the pages requested.
errors.print_pages_invalid.title: Pages cannot be printed
errors.print_pages_invalid.detail: One or more requested pages are outside the work or outside what this grant covers.
errors.print_not_ready.title: The print is not ready
errors.print_not_ready.detail: The PDF is still being prepared, or it has already been downloaded.
errors.image_source_unavailable.title: The image server did not answer
errors.image_source_unavailable.detail: The page image could not be produced right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.phone_code_invalid.title: The code was not accepted
errors.phone_code_invalid.detail: The code is wrong, has expired, or too many attempts were made. Ask for a new code.
errors.phone_send_limited.title: Too many codes
errors.phone_send_limited.detail: A code was sent recently or the hourly limit was reached. Wait before asking for another.
